articles.summary: MindWalk (NASDAQ: HYFT) executes definitive agreement with Sanabil Cayman on the terms announced in September: 7.00% fixed on drawn amounts only, no financial covenants, no warrants, no security. Undrawn at closing. MindWalk Holdings Corp. ("MindWalk") (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced that it has entered into a definitive senior unsecured revolving credit agreement with Sanabil Cayman providing a committed revolving credit facility of up to US$30 million. The agreement, dated November 16, 2026, implements the binding term sheet announced on September 14, 2026. The facility is undrawn, MindWalk is under no obligation to borrow, and no fee accrues on the undrawn commitment. "This is a supplementary instrument, not a funding plan," said Dr. Jennifer Bath, Chief Executive Officer and President of MindWalk. articles.title: MindWalk Closes US$30 Million Senior Unsecured Revolving Credit Facility

articles.summary: Multi-year agreement covers a defined deployment of ReefIQ™ and specified LensAI™ capabilities MindWalk Holdings Corp. (“MindWalk”) (NASDAQ: HYFT), a Bio-Native AI company, today announced a multi-year agreement with Teva Pharmaceuticals Australia Pty Ltd (“Teva Australia”) to deploy ReefIQ™, MindWalk’s HYFT®-powered biological context layer with specified LensAI™ analytical capabilities, in support of a defined scope of antibody-discovery work. Teva Australia will use the AI capabilities to support discovery decisions based on generated predictions and accelerate antibody design optimization. MindWalk has been collaborating with Teva Australia since 2018. “We are pleased to continue our collaboration with Teva Australia through this defined deployment,” said Jennifer Bath, PhD, President and Chief Executive Officer of MindWalk.“Across the industry, the constraint in antibody discovery is no longer generating data.
